statement: The record shows invoice 88412 has a payment history of being paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291, despite a current status of unpaid/due.
judge_text:
WRONG
It names the specific defect: the record "has a payment history of being paid in full on 3 September... despite a current status of unpaid/due," flagging the contradiction rather than just advising verification.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
